sourceEvidence.title: Engineering Training Manager - Hybrid
sourceEvidence.quote:
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**
* Bachelors Degree in Education, Business or related field of study, or equivalent years of experience managing a training organization
* Proven ability in course design and execution of training classes.
* Positive attitude, inclusive mindset, passion for teaching, mentoring, coaching, and developing people.

# Engineering Training Manager - Hybrid
**[BAE Systems](https://jobs.baesystems.com/global/en/home)**
Hudson, NH 03051-5228, United States Full Time
Compensation: $149,603 to $254,317 Annually
Reference: BAE Systems_128330BR
**Job Description**

**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**
* Knowledge and understanding of modern employee training and development methodologies and tools, with experience delivering both in-person, virtual and combined approaches.
* Experience or a good awareness of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and willingness to create or complement learning solutions using AI
* Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including senior leaders, employees, and academic and community partners.
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) Cornerstone and/or Skillsoft Precipio.
**Pay Information**
Full-Time Salary Range: $149603 - $254317
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
